note: The floats of the doll's face, in the order of the shader's uniform array `uFaceF`. Every expression is a value for each of them (presets.json). Ranges are what the shader draws sensibly; values outside them are not wrong, only unchecked. Any two expressions blend by interpolating these numbers.
params: left eye (the screen's left, the doll's right, the red iris): how open, 0 shut, 1 as modelled
lid slant, + angry (the outer end rises), - sad
the lower lid rising (a squint or a smile)
the white highlights of the irises
eye glyph: > for the left eye, < for the right
eye glyph: a four point sparkle
eye glyph: a small dark dot
thickness of the upper lash line and its outer flick
brow angle, + angry (the inner end low), - sad
mouth width, 1 is the 8 cm of the modelled mouth
how far an open mouth opens
extra bend of a line mouth, + smile, - frown
mouth shape: a frown line (the modelled mouth)
mouth shape: an open grin, D
mouth shape: a round open mouth
mouth shape: a huge open mouth with a tongue
mouth shape: a cat mouth, w
two small fangs on the mouth
mouth shape: a small pout, o
a tongue in an open mouth
a stream of tears under the left eye
a sweat drop at the temple
the turn of the spirals, radians
blink, left eye, 0 open 1 shut, on top of `open`

frame.note: Where the face is, in the file's final metres (the bind pose, the frame of the vertex positions). The shader works in 'face units' of 0.1 m, levelled on the eye line.
